test_PipeRPCWrapper_basic: test the PipeRPCWrapper class with a basic two-layer model using RPC across two workers
test_PipeRPCWrapper_optimizer: test the PipeRPCWrapper optimizer registration and stepping across multiple RPC workers with layer reuse
test_PipeRPCWrapper_megatron: test the PipeRPCWrapper with Megatron model parallel layers including ColumnParallelLinear and RowParallelLinear
test_PipeRPCWrapper_reuse_final_stage: test the PipeRPCWrapper backward pass logic when reused layers appear in the final pipeline stage
test_PipeRPCWrapper_construct_rank_zero: test that PipeRPCWrapper construction fails with an assertion error when called from a non-zero rank
